instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot at eye-level. Inside a bright ballet studio with a white wall and double wooden ballet barres, two young boys pose. On the left, the red-haired boy in a blue t-shirt and black shorts (R5) stands straight with his hands resting near his waist, looking forward. On the right, the brown-haired boy in a blue t-shirt and black shorts (R4) stands with slightly bent knees, raising his left arm high while keeping his right arm low, looking forward with an alert expression. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting, highlighting the natural wood of the barres and the deep blue of their shirts.
